note: WHAT'S NEW screen (docs/whats-new-spec.md). Newest update first; only the newest is shown, once, to returning players. For each player-facing release add an entry at the top with a new id. Entries: one short sentence each, tag NEW / UI / BALANCE / MOVES / AI, optional credit line. Aim for 6 or fewer; past 8 the list scrolls. Plain ASCII apostrophes and quotes.

entries.text: Battles remember each Forgeling's last move.

Beating stronger foes levels you up faster.
